subroutine heapsort(n,array)
  implicit none
  integer,intent(in) :: n
  integer,intent(inout) :: array(1:n)
  
  integer ::i,k,j,l
  integer :: t
  
  if(n.le.0)then
     write(6,*)"Error, at heapsort"; stop
  endif
  if(n.eq.1)return

  l=n/2+1
  k=n
  do while(k.ne.1)
     if(l.gt.1)then
        l=l-1
        t=array(L)
     else
        t=array(k)
        array(k)=array(1)
        k=k-1
        if(k.eq.1) then
           array(1)=t
           exit
        endif
     endif
     i=l
     j=l+l
     do while(j.le.k)
        if(j.lt.k)then
           if(array(j).lt.array(j+1))j=j+1
        endif
        if (t.lt.array(j))then
           array(i)=array(j)
           i=j

        else

        endif

  enddo

proc less[T1,T2]( x :T1, y :T2 ) :bool = x < y

iterator range( N :int ) :int =
    for i in range(0, N):

iterator reverse( L, R :int ) :int =

type vect[T] = seq[T]

proc Vect[T]( n :int ): vect[T] =
    newSeq[T]( result, n )

proc elem[T]( e :T, s :varargs[T] ) :bool =
    for a in s:
        if e == a: return true
    return false

###   tens   ###
################
type tens[T] = object
    data :vect[T]
    shape :vect[int]

proc Tens[T]( S :varargs[int] ) :tens[T] =
    var N :int = 1
    for s in S: N *= s
    result.data = Vect[T](N)
    result.shape = @S

proc `[]`[T]( t :tens[T], s :varargs[int] ) :T =
    var n = 0
    var r = 1
    for i in reverse(s.len):
        n += s[i] * r
        r *= t.shape[i]
    return t.data[n]

proc `[]=`[T]( t :var tens[T], s :varargs[int], e :T ) =
    var n = 0
    var r = 1
    for i in reverse(s.len):
        n += s[i] * r
        r *= t.shape[i]
    t.data[n] = e

###   stack   ###

type stack[T] = object
    data :vect[T]

proc Stack[T]() :stack[T] =
    result.data = Vect[T] 0

proc `$`[T]( s :stack[T] ) :string = $s.data
proc exist[T]( s :stack[T] ) :bool = s.data.len > 0
proc push[T]( s :var stack[T], e :T ) = s.data.add e
proc front[T]( s :stack[T] ) :T = s.data[s.data.len - 1]
proc trash[T]( s :var stack[T] ) = s.data.setLen(s.data.len - 1)
proc pop[T]( s :var stack[T] ) :T =
    result = s.front
    s.trash

###   priority   ###
####################
type priority[T] = object
    data :vect[T]
    compare :proc(x,y:T):bool

proc Priority[T]() :priority[T] =
    result.data = Vect[T](1)
    result.compare = less

proc Priority[T]( compare :proc(x,y:T):bool ) :priority[T] =
    result.data = Vect[T](1)
    result.compare = compare

template parent( n :int ) :int = n div 2
template left( n :int ) :int = n * 2
template right( n :int ) :int = n * 2 + 1

proc exist[T]( p :priority[T] ) :bool = p.data.len > 0
proc push[T]( p :var priority[T], e :T ) =
    var n = p.data.len
    p.data.add(e)
    while n.parent != 0 and p.compare( p.data[n], p.data[n.parent] ):
        swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.parent] )
        n = n.parent
proc front[T]( p :priority[T] ) :T = p.data[1]
proc trash[T]( p :var priority[T] ) =
    let N = p.data.len - 1
    p.data[1] = p.data[N]
    p.data.setLen(N)
    var n = 1
    while true:
        if n.left >= N: break
        if n.right >= N:
            if p.compare( p.data[n], p.data[n.left] ): break
            swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.left] )
            n = n.left
            continue
        if not p.compare( p.data[n.left], p.data[n] ) and
           not p.compare( p.data[n.right], p.data[n] ):
            break
        if p.compare( p.data[n.left], p.data[n.right] ):
            swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.left] )
            n = n.left
        else:
            swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.right] )
            n = n.right
proc pop[T]( p :var priority[T] ) :T =
    result = p.front
    p.trash

const MOD :int = 1000000007
type mint = distinct int

proc Mint[I]( n :I ) :mint =
    var n = n.int mod Mod
    if n < 0: n = n + MOD
    return n.mint

proc `$`( m :mint ) :string = $m.int
proc `+`[I]( m: mint, n: I ) :mint = (m.int + n.int).Mint
proc `-`[I]( m: mint, n: I ) :mint = (m.int - n.int).Mint
proc `*`[I]( m: mint, n: I ) :mint = (m.int * n.int).Mint
proc `div`[I]( m :mint, n :I ) :mint =
    var
        a = n.int
        b = MOD
        u = 1
        v = 0
    while b > 0:
        var t = a div b
        a -= t * b
        u -= t * v
        swap( a, b )
        swap( u, v )
    return m * u

proc `^`[T](n :T, m :int) :T =
    var n = n
    var m = m
    result = 1.T
    while m > 0:
        if m mod 2 != 0: result = result * n
        n = n * n
        m = m div 2

proc fact[I]( n :I ) :I =
    var memo {.global.} :seq[I] = @[I(1)]
    if n.int >= memo.len:
        let m :int = memo.len
        memo.setLen(n.int + 1)
        for i in m..n.int:
            memo[i] = memo[i-1] * i
    return memo[n.int]

proc sort[T]( S :var openArray[T], compare :proc(x,y:T):bool ) =
    var stack = Stack[ (bool,int,int) ]()
    stack.push( (true, 0, S.len) )
    while stack.exist:
        var (B, L, R) = stack.pop
        if R - L < 2: continue
        if B:
            stack.push( (false, L, R) )
            stack.push( (true, L, (L+R) div 2) )
            stack.push( (true, (L+R) div 2, R) )
            continue

        var temp = Vect[T]( (L+R) div 2 - L )
        for i in range( temp.len ): temp[i] = S[L+i]
        var (l, r) = (0, (L+R) div 2)
        for i in range(L,R):
            if r == R or l != temp.len and compare(temp[l], S[r] ):
                S[i] = temp[l]
                l.inc
            else:
                S[i] = S[r]
                r.inc


proc sort[T]( S :var openArray[T] ) =
    S.sort less

proc argMax[T]( V :openArray[T] ) :int =
    var max = T.low
    for i, e in V:
        if e > max:
            result = i
            max = e

proc read( T :typedesc ) :T =
    when T is char:
        proc getchar() :char {.header:"stdio.h",importc:"getchar".}
        result = getchar()

    when T is string:
        result = ""
        while true:
            var c = char.read
            if c.elem( ' ', '\10', '\255' ): break
            result.add c

    when T is (int or lint):
        result = 0
        while true:
            var c = char.read
            if c < '0' or '9' < c: break
            result *= 10
            result += c.int() - '0'.int()

    when T is tuple:
        for r in result.fields:
            r = r.type.read

proc read( T :typedesc, N :int ) :vect[T] =
    result = Vect[T](N)
    for i in range(N):
        result[i] = T.read

    local odds_array = {}

solve :: [Int] -> Int
solve = uncurry (+) . chop . split ([],[])
  where
    split :: ([Int], [Int]) -> [Int] -> ([Int], [Int])
    split (xs, ys) [x,y]        = (x : xs, y : ys)

    split _ _                   = error "split: Unhandled case"

    chop :: ([Int], [Int]) -> (Int, Int)
    chop = mapP (length . concat) . initP .
             mapP (sortBy (\a b -> compare (length a) (length b)) .
                     group . sort)
      where
        initP :: ([[Int]], [[Int]]) -> ([[Int]], [[Int]])
        initP p@(as, bs) = let (a, b) = mapP (head . last) p
                           in if a /= b
                                then (init as, init bs)
                                else let (x, y) = mapP (length . last) p
                                     in initFP ((x, as), (y, bs))
          where
            initFP :: ((Int, [[Int]]), (Int, [[Int]])) -> ([[Int]], [[Int]])
            initFP ((x, xs@[_]), (y, ys@[_]))
              | x >= y    = ([], ys)
              | otherwise = (xs, [])
            initFP ((_, xs), (_, ys@[_])) = (init2 xs, [])
            initFP ((_, xs@[_]), (_, ys)) = ([], init2 ys)

def fetch_max(h, exclude_num: -1) 
  cnt = 0
  num = 0  # Sentinel
  h.each do |k, v|
    if k == exclude_num
      next
    end
    if v > cnt
      cnt = v
      num = k
    end
  end

  [cnt, num]
end

  cnt = 0
  num = 0  # Sentinel
  h.each do |k, v|
    if k == exclude_num
      next
    end
    if v > cnt
      cnt = v
      num = k
    end
  end

  [cnt, num]
end

  max1 = hash1.values.max
  key1 = hash1.key(max1)
  max2 = hash2.values.max
  key2 = hash2.key(max2)
  ramainder = 0
  if key1 == key2

      hash2[key2] = 0
    else
      remainder = hash1[key1]
      hash1[key1] = 0
    end
  end
  how_many_changes(hash1) + how_many_changes(hash2) + remainder
end

open Printf
open Scanf

let id x = x
let pair x y = x, y

let n = scanf "%d" id
let vs = Array.init n @@ fun _ -> scanf " %d" id

module IMap = Map.Make(struct type t = int let compare = Pervasives.compare end)

let odd = ref IMap.empty
let even = ref IMap.empty

let incrmap mapr key =
  if IMap.mem key !mapr then
    mapr := IMap.add key (IMap.find key !mapr + 1) !mapr
  else
    mapr := IMap.add key 1 !mapr

let maxi mapr =
  let lis = IMap.bindings !mapr in
  let lis = List.sort (fun (k1,v1) (k1,v2) -> v2 - v1) lis in
  match lis with
  | [] -> failwith ""
  | (v, n) :: rest -> (v, n, rest)

let () =
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    if i mod 2 == 0 then begin
      incrmap odd vs.(i)
    end else begin
      incrmap even vs.(i)
    end
  done;
  let (k1, v1, rest1) = maxi odd in
  let (k2, v2, rest2) = maxi even in
  let run k1 k2 v1 v2 rest1 rest2 =
    if k1 <> k2 then begin
      let n1 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest1 in
      let n2 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest2 in
      n1 + n2
    end else if v1 > v2 then begin
      let n1 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest1 in
      match rest2 with
      | [] -> n1 + n / 2
      | (k, v) :: _ -> n1 + n / 2 - v
    end else if v1 < v2 then begin
      let n2 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest2 in
      match rest1 with
      | [] -> n2 + n / 2
      | (k, v) :: _ -> n2 + n / 2 - v 
    end else begin
      (* k1 = k2, v1 = v2 *)
      let rec loop rest1 rest2 =
        match rest1, rest2 with
        | [], [] -> 0
        | [], (k', v') :: rest' -> v'
        | (k', v') :: rest', [] -> v'
        | (k1', v1') :: rest1', (k2', v2') :: rest2' ->
          if v1' < v2' then
            let n1 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest1' in
            let n2 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest2' in
            n1 + n2 + v2'
          else if v1' > v2' then
            let n1 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest1' in
            let n2 = List.fold_left (fun acc (v, n) -> acc + n) 0 rest2' in
            n1 + n2 + v1'
          else n / 0 (* loop rest1' rest2' *)
      in
      v1 + loop rest1 rest2
    end
  in
  let result = run k1 k2 v1 v2 rest1 rest2 in
  printf "%d\n" result

    (IntMap.empty, IntMap.empty) vs in
  Printf.printf "%d\n" @@ ( - ) n @@

    IntMap.bindings odds,

    IntMap.bindings evens
  with
  | [(u, l)], [(v, m)] ->
      if u = v then max l m else l + m
  | (u, l) :: (_, m) :: _, [(v, n)] -> 
      if u = v then max l (m + n) else l + n
  | [(u, l)], (v, m) :: (_, n) :: _ -> 
      if u = v then max (l + n) m else l + m
  | (u, l) :: (_, m) :: _, (v, n) :: (_, o) :: _ ->
      if u = v then max (l + o) (m + n) else l + n

proc Tens[T]( S :varargs[int] ) :tens[T] =
    var N :int = 1
    for s in S: N *= s
    result.data = Vect[T](N)

proc `[]`[T]( t :tens[T], s :varargs[int] ) :T =
    var n = 0
    var r = 1
    for i in reverse(s.len):
        n += s[i] * r
        r *= t.shape[i]
    return t.data[n]

    var n = 0
    var r = 1
    for i in reverse(s.len):
        n += s[i] * r
        r *= t.shape[i]
    t.data[n] = e

type priority[T] = object
    data :vect[T]
    compare :proc(x,y:T):bool

proc Priority[T]() :priority[T] =
    result.data = Vect[T](1)
    result.compare = less

proc Priority[T]( compare :proc(x,y:T):bool ) :priority[T] =
    result.data = Vect[T](1)
    result.compare = compare

template parent( n :int ) :int = n div 2
template left( n :int ) :int = n * 2
template right( n :int ) :int = n * 2 + 1

proc exist[T]( p :priority[T] ) :bool = p.data.len > 0
proc push[T]( p :var priority[T], e :T ) =
    var n = p.data.len
    p.data.add(e)
    while n.parent != 0 and p.compare( p.data[n], p.data[n.parent] ):
        swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.parent] )
        n = n.parent
proc front[T]( p :priority[T] ) :T = p.data[1]
proc trash[T]( p :var priority[T] ) =
    let N = p.data.len - 1
    p.data[1] = p.data[N]
    p.data.setLen(N)
    var n = 1
    while true:
        if n.left >= N: break
        if n.right >= N:
            if p.compare( p.data[n], p.data[n.left] ): break
            swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.left] )
            n = n.left
            continue
        if not p.compare( p.data[n.left], p.data[n] ) and
           not p.compare( p.data[n.right], p.data[n] ):
            break
        if p.compare( p.data[n.left], p.data[n.right] ):
            swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.left] )
            n = n.left
        else:
            swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.right] )
            n = n.right
proc pop[T]( p :var priority[T] ) :T =
    result = p.front
    p.trash

const MOD :int = 1000000007
type mint = distinct int

proc Mint[I]( n :I ) :mint =
    var n = n.int mod Mod
    if n < 0: n = n + MOD
    return n.mint

proc `$`( m :mint ) :string = $m.int
proc `+`[I]( m: mint, n: I ) :mint = (m.int + n.int).Mint
proc `-`[I]( m: mint, n: I ) :mint = (m.int - n.int).Mint
proc `*`[I]( m: mint, n: I ) :mint = (m.int * n.int).Mint
proc `div`[I]( m :mint, n :I ) :mint =
    var
        a = n.int
        b = MOD
        u = 1
        v = 0
    while b > 0:
        var t = a div b
        a -= t * b
        u -= t * v
        swap( a, b )
        swap( u, v )
    return m * u

proc `^`[T](n :T, m :int) :T =
    var n = n
    var m = m
    result = 1.T
    while m > 0:
        if m mod 2 != 0: result = result * n
        n = n * n
        m = m div 2

proc fact[I]( n :I ) :I =
    var memo {.global.} :seq[I] = @[I(1)]
    if n.int >= memo.len:
        let m :int = memo.len
        memo.setLen(n.int + 1)
        for i in m..n.int:
            memo[i] = memo[i-1] * i
    return memo[n.int]

proc sort[T]( S :var openArray[T], compare :proc(x,y:T):bool ) =
    var stack = Stack[ (bool,int,int) ]()
    stack.push( (true, 0, S.len) )
    while stack.exist:
        var (B, L, R) = stack.pop
        if R - L < 2: continue
        if B:
            stack.push (false, L, R)
            stack.push (true, L, (L+R) div 2)
            stack.push (true, (L+R) div 2, R)
            continue

        let temp = S[L..<(L+R) div 2]
        var (l, r) = (0, (L+R) div 2)
        for i in range(L,R):
            if r == R or l != temp.len and compare(temp[l], S[r] ):
                S[i] = temp[l]
                l.inc
            else:
                S[i] = S[r]
                r.inc

proc read( T :typedesc ) :T =
    when T is char:
        proc getchar() :char {.header:"stdio.h",importc:"getchar".}
        result = getchar()

    when T is string:
        result = ""
        while true:
            var c = char.read
            if c.elem( ' ', '\10', '\255' ): break
            result.add c

    when T is (int or lint):
        result = 0
        while true:
            var c = char.read
            if c < '0' or '9' < c: break
            result *= 10
            result += c.int() - '0'.int()

    when T is tuple:
        for r in result.fields:
            r = r.type.read

proc read( T :typedesc, N :int ) :vect[T] =
    result = Vect[T](N)
    for i in range(N):
        result[i] = T.read

    var n = p.data.len
    p.data.add(e)
    while n.parent != 0 and p.compare( p.data[n], p.data[n.parent] ):
        swap( p.data[n], p.data[n.parent] )

proc sort[T]( S :var openArray[T], compare :proc(x,y:T):bool ) =
    var stack = Stack[ (bool,int,int) ]()
    stack.push( (true, 0, S.len) )
    while stack.exist:
        var (B, L, R) = stack.pop
        if R - L < 2: continue
        if B:
            stack.push( (false, L, R) )
            stack.push( (true, L, (L+R) div 2) )
            stack.push( (true, (L+R) div 2, R) )
            continue

        var temp = Vect[T]( (L+R) div 2 - L )
        for i in range( temp.len ): temp[i] = S[L+i]
        var (l, r) = (0, (L+R) div 2)
        for i in range(L,R):
            if r == R or l != temp.len and compare(temp[l], S[r] ):
                S[i] = temp[l]
                l.inc
            else:
                S[i] = S[r]
                r.inc

def check_num(numlist, num):
    index = len(numlist)
    if num in numlist:
        indexs = [i for i, x in enumerate(numlist) if x == num]
        for i in range(len(indexs)):
            if indexs[i]%2 == 0:
                index = indexs[i]
    if index == len(numlist):
        numlist.append(num)
        numlist.append(1)
    else:
        numlist[index+1] += 1

    return numlist

def solve(size=int(input()), ary=list(map(int, input().split()))):

                pu += d
                pv += d
                ans.append('R')

                pu += d
                pv -= d
                ans.append('U')
            elif pu >= u and pv >= v:
                pu -= d
                pv -= d
                ans.append('L')
            elif pu >= u and pv <= v:
                pu -= d
                pv += d
                ans.append('U')
        print(*ans, sep = '')

def solution(n: int, vs: list):
    map_a = collections.defaultdict(lambda: 0)
    map_b = collections.defaultdict(lambda: 0)

    for i in range(0, n, 2):
        map_a[vs[i]] += 1
        map_b[vs[i+1]] += 1

    pair_a = [(k, map_a[k]) for k in map_a.keys()]        
    pair_b = [(k, map_b[k]) for k in map_b.keys()]

    pair_a = sorted(pair_a, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse= True)
    pair_b = sorted(pair_b, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse= True)

import sys
import collections

sys.setrecursionlimit(10 ** 6)

read_single_int = lambda: int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
read_list_int = lambda: list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split(' ')))


def solution(n: int, vs: list):
    map_a = collections.defaultdict(lambda: 0)
    map_b = collections.defaultdict(lambda: 0)

    for i in range(0, n, 2):
        map_a[vs[i]] += 1
        map_b[vs[i+1]] += 1


    pair_a = [(k, map_a[k]) for k in map_a.keys()]        
    pair_b = [(k, map_b[k]) for k in map_b.keys()]

    pair_a = sorted(pair_a, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse= True)
    pair_b = sorted(pair_b, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse= True)

    first_a, second_a = pair_a[0], (0, 0) if len(pair_a) == 1 else pair_a[1]
    first_b, second_b = pair_b[0], (0, 0) if len(pair_b) == 1 else pair_b[1]

    if first_a[0] != first_b[0]:
        return n//2-first_a[1] + n//2-first_b[1]
    else:
        if first_a[1] + second_b[1] < second_a[1] + first_b[1]:
            return n//2-second_a[1] + n//2-first_b[1]
        else:
            return n//2-first_a[1] + n//2-second_b[1]

    return 0


def main():
    n = read_single_int()
    vs = read_list_int()
    print(solution(n, vs))

    # 最初、引数に1と入れていなかったことによりWA
    most1 = cnt1.most_common(1)
    most2 = cnt2.most_common(1)

        return len(arr1) - most1[0][1] + len(arr2) - most2[0][1]

                + len(arr1) - cnt1.most_common(2)[1][1]
        except:
            ans2 = len(arr2) - most2[0][1] \
                + len(arr1)

      num = [i]
      maximam = count
    elif count == maximam:

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import collections
import itertools
import sys


INVALID = -1
INF = sys.maxsize // 2


def solve(n, vs):
    up_vals = vs[::2]
    up_ctr = collections.Counter(up_vals)
    up_ctr[INVALID] = 0
    down_vals = vs[1::2]
    down_ctr = collections.Counter(down_vals)
    down_ctr[INVALID] = 0
    up_mcs = up_ctr.most_common(3)
    down_mcs = down_ctr.most_common(3)
    cost = INF
    for (k_up, v_up), (k_down, v_down) in itertools.product(up_mcs, down_mcs):
        if k_up != k_down:
            new_cost = n - v_up - v_down
            cost = min(new_cost, cost)
    return cost


def main():
    n = int(input())
    vs = [int(v) for v in input().split()]
    print(solve(n, vs))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

from collections import Counter


def main():
    r"""
    数列 a1,a2,...,anが以下の条件を満たすとき、 /\/\/\/ と呼ぶ

        各 i=1,2...,n-2 について、ai=ai+2
        数列に現れる数はちょうど 2種類偶数長の数列

    v1,v2,...,vnが与えられます
    要素をいくつか書き換えることでこの数列を /\/\/\/ にしたいです。
    書き換える要素の数は最小でいくつになるか求めてください。

    2 <= n <= 10^5, nは偶数
    1 <= vi <= 10^5, viは整数
    """
    n = int(input())
    *v, = map(int, input().split())

    ans = f(n, v)
    assert ans == simple(n, v)
    print(ans)


def simple(n, v):
    # most_commonを事前に使い短くする
    # 1種類しかないならば存在しない種類を0個で足して条件分岐を潰す
    c1 = Counter(v[::2]).most_common() + [(0, 0)]
    c2 = Counter(v[1::2]).most_common() + [(0, 0)]

    if c1[0][0] == c2[0][0]:
        n_no_change = max(c1[0][1] + c2[1][1],
                          c1[1][1] + c2[0][1])
        return n - n_no_change
    else:
        return n - c1[0][1] - c2[0][1]

def f(n, v):
    """
    3 1 3 2:
        3種類
        a1=a3, a2 != a4
    """
    ans = float("inf")
    v_idx_even = []
    v_idx_odd = []
    for i, x in enumerate(v):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            v_idx_even.append(x)
        else:
            v_idx_odd.append(x)

    ve = Counter(v_idx_even)
    vo = Counter(v_idx_odd)

    if len(ve) == 1 and len(vo) == 1:
        # 両方1種類
        ans = 0
        if ve.most_common()[0][0] == vo.most_common()[0][0]:
            ans = n // 2

    elif len(ve) == 1 or len(vo) == 1:
        # 片方1種類
        idx = 0
        if ve.most_common()[0][0] == vo.most_common()[0][0]:
            idx = 1
        if len(ve) == 1:
            ans = n // 2 - vo.most_common()[idx][1]
        else:
            ans = n // 2 - ve.most_common()[idx][1]

    else:
        # 両方2種類以上
        if ve.most_common()[0][0] != vo.most_common()[0][0]:
            ans = n - ve.most_common()[0][1] - vo.most_common()[0][1]
        else:
            ans = n - \
                max(ve.most_common()[0][1] + vo.most_common()[1][1],
                    ve.most_common()[1][1] + vo.most_common()[0][1])

    return ans


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

from collections import Counter


def answer():
    n_2 = int(input())
    assert n_2 % 2 == 0
    n = n_2 // 2
    tmp = input()
    values = [int(w) for w in tmp.split()]

    GATE_KEEPER = -1

    values_odd = values[::2]
    values_even = values[1::2]

    counts = [Counter(values_partial).most_common(2) for values_partial in [values_odd, values_even]]
    if counts[0][0][0] != counts[1][0][0]:
        # just go
        ans = sum([n - count[0][1] for count in counts])
    else:
        # replace
        # set gatekeeper
        for i in range(2):
            counts[i].append((GATE_KEEPER, 0))
        ans = min([(n - counts[0][0][1]) + (n - counts[1][1][1]),
                   (n - counts[0][1][1]) + (n - counts[1][0][1])])
    print(ans)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    answer()

import collections
import itertools


def solve(vs):
    up_vals = vs[::2]
    up_ctr = collections.Counter(up_vals)
    down_vals = vs[1::2]
    down_ctr = collections.Counter(down_vals)
    if up_vals == down_vals:
        return len(up_vals)
    up_mcs = up_ctr.most_common(3)
    down_mcs = down_ctr.most_common(3)
    g = itertools.product(up_mcs, down_mcs)
    c = min(len(up_vals) + len(down_vals) - v1 - v2 for ((k1, v1), (k2, v2)) in g if k1 != k2)
    return c


def main():
    _ = input()

    if num in numlist:
        indexs = [i for i, x in enumerate(numlist) if x == num]
        for i in range(len(indexs)):
            if indexs[i]%2 == 0:
                index = indexs[i]
    if index == len(numlist):
        numlist.append(num)
        numlist.append(1)
    else:
        numlist[index+1] += 1

    return numlist
